metadata.summary: DP World Tour chief executive Guy Kinnings has confirmed that the plan is to keep the season-ending Play-Offs in the Middle East, despite ongoing conflict in the region.
metadata.content: DP World Tour chief executive Guy Kinnings confirms plan to stage Play-Offs in Middle East, despite player safety concerns | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive DP World Tour chief executive Guy Kinnings confirms plan to stage Play-Offs in Middle East, despite player safety concerns In an exclusive interview with Sky Sports, DP World Tour chief executive Guy Kinnings discussed the plans for the season-ending Play-Offs, the Strategic Alliance with the PGA Tour and the bright future the tour has within the global game By Ali Stafford at Wentworth Sunday 20 September 2026 15:01, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Matt Fitzpatrick voices his concerns over the DP World Tour Play-Offs in the Middle East DP World Tour chief executive Guy Kinnings has confirmed that the plan is to keep the season-ending Play-Offs in the Middle East, despite ongoing conflict in the region. The Abu Dhabi Championship is scheduled to be held at Yas Links on November 5-8, before the Race to Dubai season reaches its climax at the DP World Tour Championship the following week. There has been speculation throughout the season over whether both events would move to a different country, with Formula 1 cancelling two events earlier in the year in the region and discussions ongoing over whether races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi will go ahead. messages.text: Broad excited at what Fleming can do for Root's captaincy

metadata.summary: Sky Sports Cricket's Stuart Broad is excited at what new England Test coach Stephen Fleming can bring to Joe Root's captaincy as the New Zealander prepares for his first assignment in the role in South Africa this winter.
metadata.content: Stephen Fleming: Stuart Broad excited at what new England Test cricket coach can do for Joe Root's captaincy | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Opinion Stephen Fleming: Stuart Broad excited at what new England Test cricket coach can do for Joe Root's captaincy Sky Sports pundit Stuart Broad on Stephen Fleming-Joe Root relationship: "Where Joe needs a bit of help with his captaincy is taking a bit of weight off his shoulders at times, allowing him to concentrate on batting, make tactical decisions and get feedback throughout to help England out" Stuart Broad Cricket expert Saturday 19 September 2026 20:03, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player New England Test coach Stephen Fleming says he was involved in the appointment of Joe Root as captain and explains why he expects him to be a success Sky Sports Cricket's Stuart Broad is excited at what new England Test coach Stephen Fleming can bring to Joe Root's captaincy as the New Zealander prepares for his first assignment in the role in South Africa this winter. Fleming was named as countryman Brendon McCullum's successor in late July but did not lead the side for the recent 3-0 sweep of Pakistan due to family commitments. The 53-year-old recently flew to England for a short trip to chat with ECB officials and Test skipper Root as well as the counties, and was with the national team as they completed a 3-0 T20I whitewash under white-ball coach McCullum in Manchester on Saturday .
